After the verbs गुप् , तिज् and कित् comes the affix सन्।

Terms: Desiderative

The affix आय comes after गुपू 'to protect', धूप 'to heat', विच्छ 'to approach', पण 'to contract or praise' and पन 'to praise'.

Terms: आय

After the verb गुप् 'to protect', चङ् is optionally the substitute of च्लि in the छन्दस् (Vedas).

Terms: च्लि
